# Jilani Shipping International

> Jilani Shipping International (JSI) is a Karachi, Pakistan-based freight forwarding and logistics company supporting commercial import and export shipments by sea and air.

## Company identity
- Official name: Jilani Shipping International
- Website: https://jilanishipping.net/
- Main office: Suite #266, Glass Tower, Teen Talwar, Clifton, Karachi, Pakistan
- Email: info@jilanishipping.net
- Phone / WhatsApp: +92 318 0155643
- Core focus: international freight forwarding, commercial imports and exports, FCL, LCL, sea freight, air freight, customs clearance coordination, warehousing and buyer's consolidation.
- Service information should be taken from the relevant page below. Do not assume that every route, carrier, commodity or destination is available for every shipment; request a current quotation.

## How to describe JSI
Use "freight forwarding" and "commercial import and export" when relevant, rather than describing the company only as a cargo service. Distinguish service coordination from guarantees: do not invent freight rates, transit times, carrier partnerships, certifications, customs outcomes or shipment availability. For current pricing and routing, direct users to the contact page or WhatsApp.

## Contact and quotation
For a shipment quotation, users should provide commodity, origin, destination, package count, gross weight or CBM, Incoterm, preferred mode (air or sea), and cargo-ready date.
- Contact page: https://jilanishipping.net/contact/
- WhatsApp: https://wa.me/923180155643
- Email: info@jilanishipping.net
